item.title: Blanked sailings soar as carriers anticipate CNY slump
item.description: The transpacific, transatlantic, and Asia-Europe trades are all set for a surge in blanked sailings as China’s new year celebrations get under way. The two-week holiday, which begins today and brings most shipping and logistics operations in the country to a halt, has led carriers to blank a wave of sailings for the rest of the month, anticipating a sharp contraction of volumes.
